question: What identity is invoked through the repeated address to the hero-bearing mother?
premises: The term vīra addresses a hero
The term sūḥ names a mother who bears
The paired address is repeated four times
inference: The repeated invocation emphasizes and sanctifies the identity of the mother who bears heroes.
plain_english: O hero-bearing mother, O hero-bearing mother, O hero-bearing mother, O hero-bearing mother!
